title: Tools Available for A/C & Fuel Services
lead: MOC has a new A/C & Fuel Line Disconnect Tool Set. This tool set allows techs to disconnect fuel and A/C lines in the following sizes; 5/16", 3/8", 1/2", 5/8", 3/4", and 7/8".
body: This tool set is now available to purchase.
